csharpCode: using UnityEngine; public class FindFloorInMap { public static string Run() { if (UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().name != "Map") { UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene("Assets/Scenes/Map.unity"); } UnityEngine.AI.NavMeshHit hit; if (UnityEngine.AI.NavMesh.SamplePosition(Vector3.zero, out hit, 1000f, UnityEngine.AI.NavMesh.AllAreas)) { return $"Found NavMesh at: {hit.position}"; } return "No NavMesh found in Map scene!"; } }
